movement_profile.arms_and_hands: predominantly arm movements, drawing from glowsticking techniques such as freehand patterns, the figure eight, and the concept of a leading hand
movement_profile.footwork: shuffling steps and rhythmic footwork, sometimes incorporating elements of toprock and b-boy-style footwork
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: dancers tend to use their hips, knees, and feet smoothly across the floor

signature_moves.description: A geometric arm pattern where hands follow a figure-eight path.
signature_moves.name: Figure Eight

signature_moves.description: A technique where one hand geometrically follows the movement of the other.
signature_moves.name: Leading Hand

music_profile.sound_description: Fast-paced, high-energy electronic music characterized by repetitive, driving beats and synthesized melodies typical of early 2000s European club culture.
